en.headline: Chan says firms accelerating supply-chain diversification amid geopolitical uncertainty
en.dek: The Financial Secretary told the AFRC Regional Regulatory Forum that Hong Kong saw 121 new listings in the first 10 months raising over HK$400 billion, up 40 per cent on all of last year.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said companies are accelerating moves to diversify supply chains and spread investment as geopolitical uncertainty persists, while closer regional economic ties are driving higher demand for reliable cross-border financial information.

Speaking at the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council’s Regional Regulatory Forum, Chan noted that developments in trade, technology and green transition create opportunities but also raise new requirements for trust and accountability. He said Hong Kong is well placed at the forefront of these trends.

In the first 10 months of this year the city recorded 121 new listings that raised more than HK$400 billion, 40 per cent more than the whole of last year. About 60 per cent of the new issuers have international operations, and some have stated in their prospectuses that proceeds will fund overseas expansion. More companies from Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Central Asia are also choosing Hong Kong for listings or bond issues.

Chan said artificial intelligence can handle routine work efficiently but its limitations and the validity of its assumptions still require rigorous professional judgement. He also highlighted the risk of AI-generated forgeries, which makes the reliability of evidence more important. The profession must continue to meet its duties and raise the skills of management and staff.

He outlined three priorities: place integrity at the core of work and never compromise on quality or ethics; go beyond acquiring AI skills to become “AI native”, as firms will value people who can use the technology to transform or reshape business models; and keep investing in people. Although AI may reduce some routine tasks, firms must still give young professionals the training and experience needed to develop technological and commercial understanding, sound judgement, integrity, and the ability to work effectively across markets and cultures.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：地緣政治不確定下企業加速供應鏈多元化
zh.dek: 財政司司長在會財局區域監管論壇表示，今年首十個月本港有121宗新股上市，集資逾4000億元，較去年全年增四成。
body: 財政司司長陳茂波表示，在全球地緣政治不確定性下，企業正加速推動供應鏈多元化及分散投資，同時區域經濟聯繫日益緊密，對跨境可信財務資訊的需求大幅上升。
陳茂波出席會財局區域監管論壇時指出，貿易、科技和綠色轉型等方面的發展在創造機遇的同時，也對信任和問責提出新要求，香港正處於這些趨勢的前沿位置。
他提到，今年首十個月本港共有121宗新股上市，集資額超過4000億港元，比去年全年增加40%。約60%的新發行人擁有國際業務營運，部分更在招股章程中明確將上市所得款項用於海外擴張，亦有更多來自東南亞、中東和中亞的國際企業選擇來香港上市或發行債券。
陳茂波說，人工智能可以高效承擔常規工作，但其局限性及基於假設的有效性仍需專業判斷嚴格審視，亦關注人工智能偽造文件的風險，令證據可靠性更為重要。業界必須設法履行職責，並提升管理層和員工技能。
他提出三點優先：將誠信置於工作核心，永遠不要在質量和誠信上妥協；不只要建立人工智能技能，更要成為「AI原生」，因為企業將更看重能利用人工智能協助轉型或重塑商業模式的人；以及持續投資於人。雖然人工智能可能減少部分日常工作，但事務所仍須為年輕專業人士提供所需訓練及經驗，以培訓出兼具科技與商業理解力、能作出穩健判斷、堅守誠信並能跨市場、跨文化有效合作的專業人才。
